name: Ontology Values Present
description: A Capability Definition is published only when every composable value in it exists in the Ontology.

conditions.statement: Every composable value of the Capability Definition exists in the Ontology before the Capability Definition moves from Defined to Published.

requiredEvidence.title: Ontology Check Record
requiredEvidence.description: The result of checking the composable values of the Capability Definition against the Ontology.
